properties.description: Anthony keeps as intent that a reflow2 design lives in its server rather than in the code repository it describes, saving itself wherever its owner chooses, while reflow2 keeps the link to every implementation. req:persistence ("the design persists in-repo alongside the code") is retired on Anthony's word and replaced by the principle underneath it: design and implementation stay coherent in both directions.
properties.name: 2026-09-25: a design lives apart from its code, and coherence between them becomes the principle
